description: Erection of a single storey rear extension, single storey side extension and two storey side extension to the house.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall begin not later than three years from the date of this decision.

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and specifications: [PL/A519/11, PL/A519/12, PL/A519/13, PL/A519/14 & PL/A519/20. Received on 20/07/2022; PL/A519/20 & Fire Statement, Received on 29/07/2022; PL/A519/15 Rev A. Received on 12/10/2022; PL/A519/16 Rev B, PL/A519/17 Rev B, PL/A519/18 Rev B & PL/A5/19/19 Rev B. Received on 01/11/2022].

Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the development hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building, unless otherwise shown on the approved plans.

Condition : 4 - The windows formed in the [south west] elevation shall be obscure-glazed and non-opening below 1.7 metres above internal floor level. The windows shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than in accordance with the requirements of this condition.
Condition : 5 - No additional windows or openings shall be formed in the side elevations of the development hereby permitted.
Condition : 6 - No part of the development (including any guttering) shall overhang land outside of the ownership of the owner of the application property.
